scripts.predev: node scripts/sync-tokens.mjs && node scripts/optimize-textures.mjs && node scripts/optimize-images.mjs
scripts.prebuild: node scripts/sync-tokens.mjs && node scripts/optimize-textures.mjs && node scripts/optimize-images.mjs
scripts.model:optimize: cd public/model && npx --yes @gltf-transform/cli@latest dedup hero.glb _a.glb && npx --yes @gltf-transform/cli@latest weld _a.glb _b.glb && npx --yes @gltf-transform/cli@latest simplify _b.glb _c.glb --error 0.001 && npx --yes @gltf-transform/cli@latest draco _c.glb hero.glb && rm -f _a.glb _b.glb _c.glb
scripts.model:codegen: npx --yes gltfjsx@latest public/model/hero.glb --types --keepnames --root public/ --output src/components/three/hero/HeroModel.generated.tsx && node scripts/fix-gltfjsx.mjs
scripts.model:update: npm run model:optimize && npm run model:codegen
